correctness.rationale: Direct symbolic differentiation of P=z+(p/2)x²−qxy+(q/2)y² gives dot P=c−kx−q(x−y)²; compact invariant probability makes E[dot P|P]=0 via antiderivative tests. Likewise dot y=x−y gives E[x|y]=y and E(x−y)²=Var x−Var y. If defect is zero, invariant support lies in x=y, hence y constant, x constant, z=0, and x=c/k. Mean trace −1−px+qy gives the exact contraction-gap formula and strictness when p>q>0. For ergodic compact measures Liouville and Oseledets yield the stated exponent sum; no numerical chaotic measure existence is assumed.
